During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents undertook a '''mission''' to an [[Imperial supply depot (Rainos Cluster)|Imperial supply depot]] in the [[Rainos Cluster/Legends|Rainos Cluster]]. The objective of the mission was to retrieve from the [[Baas-class space station|supply depot]] replacement [[KL-45 coolant hydro-valve]]s that were needed to prevent the destruction of an [[Obas base|Alliance base]] on the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Obas]].<ref name="Meltdown" />
